'''Hacklin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and a loyal ally of [[Darth Angral]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the Admiral encountered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] when the woman was captured by Angral's forces, Hacklin was impersonated by the [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]] [[Valis]] in order to lure Carsen and [[Hero of Tython|her Master]] into a [[Duel at the Czerka mining facility|trap]] on an abandoned [[Czerka asteroid mining facility|mining facility]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of Darth Angral's closest advisors&mdash;Admiral Hacklin&mdash;asked us for asylum. He wants to defect.''"<br />"''Hacklin was with Angral when he interrogated me on Ord Mantell. They seemed chummy. What changed?''"<br />"''Not sure, but the admiral is on the run. There are unconfirmed reports Hacklin's earned a death mark.|General Suthra and Kira Carsen|<ref name="The Defector" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Hacklin was an [[Advisor/Legends|adviser]] to, and ally of, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="The Defector" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Hacklin accompanied the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]<ref name="The Defector" /> to the [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] [[Ord Mantell Orbital Station|Orbital Station]] when Angral's [[Spy/Legends|spies]] identified [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]]'s presence on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Angral, who was searching for [[Hero of Tython|Carsen's Master]] in an effort to avenge the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], interrogated Carsen with Hacklin and [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] [[Ferav]], though Carsen managed to trick the trio into believing the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] was on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Hacklin and Angral departed the station in order to oversee the installation of the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] onto Angral's warship, the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']].<ref name="New Intelligence">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|New Intelligence|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

Not long afterward, the [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]] [[Valis]] used Hacklin's name to draw out Carsen&mdash;who was a former Child herself&mdash;and her Master in an [[Duel at the Czerka mining facility|attempt]] to capture her. Valis, impersonating Hacklin, contacted Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] and claimed that he wanted to defect, asking for a meeting with the Knight and Carsen. He also instigated rumors that the Admiral had earned a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] in order to lend credence to the lead. When the Knight and Carsen arrived at the [[Czerka asteroid mining facility|abandoned mining facility]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that Suthra had selected, Valis informed the pair that Hacklin remained very loyal to the Empire and Angral before apologizing for the deception.<ref name="The Defector" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hacklin was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He is first mentioned in the Jedi Knight class mission "New Intelligence," but he is not named until "The Defector," in which the Child of the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] Valis uses Hacklin's name to draw out Kira Carsen and the player.<ref name="The Defector" />
